name: Rev. M. G. Johnson byyu
bio: Born into a lifelong heritage of faith and ministry, Rev. M. G. Johnson is the son of the late Rev. M. Y. George, who faithfully served in the pastoral ministry of the Assemblies of God for 50 years.

After finishing his secular studies (M.A) and theological studies at Union Biblical Seminary, Pune (B.D) and Gurukul Lutheran Theological College, Chennai (M.Th), Rev. Johnson served as a faculty member at Bethel Bible College, Punalur.

Following his arrival to the United States, he served as Pastor for numerous congregations including Sharon Fellowship Church Dallas, Salem Assemblies of God New York, Gilgal Pentecostal Assembly Chicago, and Philadelphia Pentecostal Church Chicago.

He has also served in various ministerial roles: 2006 Sharon Conference Convener, AGIFNA Secretary, AG Eastern Region President, and Coordinator for the Fellowship of Pentecostal Churches in Chicago (FPCC).
He is married to Sis. Mini Johnson and has three children and two grandchildren. He currently resides in Vernon Hills, IL.
